column1: # Game profile of STEINS;GATE RE:BOOT (Switch, base game v0 + update 1.0.3 = v131072). Plays on the Mac and on the iPhone
# M2's ADV engine ("advengine", m2lib, the E-mote player for the animated characters), SDK 20.5.17 (the same SDK generation as Breath of the Wild and Tears of the Kingdom), NVN.
# RomFS: the game's own PSB archives (<name>_info.psb.m index + <name>_body.bin data, mzs-compressed but for the plain PSB sound and voice bodies; its sound goes through the
# hardware Opus decoder calls, hle_codec.c) and 87 H.264 / AAC MP4 movies in movie/, demuxed by the SDK's movie::Extractor in subsdk0 and decoded by the host (decoder output 4, buffer mode),
# the AAC sound played through an AudioOut whose volume the game sets every frame (SetAudioOutVolume, hle_audio.c). The title menu's background is one of those movies.
# Shaders: 5 BNSH in main, 487 shaders (483 pixel, 4 vertex); RomFS holds none.
# The game draws 1280x720 in a 1920x1080 window and crops it in both modes: its render size setting is 1920x1080 docked by its constructor (main+0x383eb0) and its start-up code sets it
# to 1280x720 (main+0x17c50 → the setter main+0x389e90), whatever the host reports. It reads the touch screen in handheld mode but takes no input from it, so the default docked mode stays.
# Controls (its HELP screen): A enter, B cancel / hide text, X back log, Y auto mode, L force skip, R skip mode, ZL / ZR phone trigger, − tips, + system menu, R3 quick save (the 3D pad layout)
# Into the story from a quick save: A on the title, Right to CONTINUE, A, Right to QUICK LOAD, A, A on the save, Left to OK, A. The menu takes presses late and unevenly while its
# background movie starts (100 to 500 frames after the title's A in Mac runs), so a DM_KEYS route needs its frames checked with screenshots

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# only the merged 1.0.3 copy is extracted; the base game's own build IDs are added when needed
# subsdk0 is the SDK's movie library (movie::Extractor runs in it; the host replaces movie::Decoder, hle_movie.c)
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize (3.05 GB). The modules take about 35 MB, under the default used memory.
# 13 Sentinels' partition (4 GB block = 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region), as the other games without virtual address memory
